structured_spec.feature_identity: First Real OR Pilot for Bounded Janus Delegation
structured_spec.user_value: Enables cheaper external worker path for low-risk Janus work while maintaining local validation, diff review, and final acceptance control
structured_spec.user_action_surface: Delegated write task submission through bounded janus interface
structured_spec.system_behavior: One tiny allowlisted quickchange returns a reviewable diff, changed-files list, validation evidence, and explicit Codex-owned accept-or-reject handoff. Any missing artifact, allowlist escape, or validation failure falls back to local Codex handling.
structured_spec.data_persistence: Changes are tracked through diff, changed-files list, and validation evidence artifacts
constraints: Only one tiny allowlisted quickchange allowed
All artifacts must be present for successful delegation
No authority drift in delegation process
structured_spec.security_privacy: No sensitive data handling required; all artifacts are reviewable and traceable
definition_of_done: No authority drift in delegation process
structured_spec.test_strategy: Validate delegation process with one real quickchange, verify all artifacts are generated, test failure scenarios with missing artifacts or validation failures
